editorial.blurb: Mezze Mediterranean Grill brings vibrant, meticulously crafted Mediterranean flavors to Bronzeville, with a passionate owner who perfects every detail from the hand-cut fries to the family-secret sides.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask about the hummus sampler platter to try multiple flavor profiles before committing, and don't miss the seasonal items the owner is perfecting—arrive during patio season to enjoy the beautiful outdoor seating.

topDishes.note: Moist, perfectly seasoned with generous portions and excellent house-made sauces
Authentic taste with generous portions and friendly service
